text:
Before: apple juice or tea (~200 ml), brownie (~60 g), toasted ham and cheese sandwich (~130 g), 4 salmon maki (~120 g), a fried spring roll (~60 g), a fresh spring roll (~100 g), soy sauce, and edamame.

After: the drink is mostly gone, with a little water-like liquid left. The brownie, sandwich, and maki are all eaten. The fried roll is gone. Part of the fresh roll remains (about 40 g), along with some lettuce scraps. The edamame cup still has some green content, so it was perhaps partly eaten. Soy sauce remains.

If the drink is apple juice, 200 ml is about 90 kcal; if it is tea, it is near 0. The color looks like apple juice, so I count it as juice.

| Item | Mass (g) | kcal |
|---|---|---|
| Brownie | 60 | 260 |
| Sandwich | 130 | 340 |
| Maki | 120 | 180 |
| Fried roll | 60 | 140 |
| Fresh roll (eaten part) | 60 | 70 |
| Juice | 190 | 85 |
| Lettuce | — | ~0 |
| **Total** | **620** | **1075** |
